razao: The Grid domain involves navigating and moving keys to target locations, which requires long plans. P21 uses a portfolio combining width-based/novelty search with standard state-space search and multiple heuristics (delete-relaxation, causal-graph, landmarks). This hybrid portfolio architecture is highly robust and consistently achieves state-of-the-art coverage on classical domains.
